    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_ncell - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_ttgc_1!(beta, c, cell_vol, dt, gamma, i_cell_to_node, i_ncell, res, res2, skx, sky, skz, u)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_nnode - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_ttgc_2!(i_nnode, node_vol, res, up)
    for i_ = 1:i_njac
        @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_nnode - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_ttgc_3!(i_nnode, mup)
        @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_ncell - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_ttgc_4!(cell_vol, i_cell_to_node, i_ncell, mup, up)
        @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_nnode - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_ttgc_5!(i_nnode, mup, node_vol, res, up)
    end
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_ncell - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_ttgc_6!(c, dt, i_cell_to_node, i_ncell, res2, skx, sky, u, up)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_nnode - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_ttgc_7!(i_nnode, node_vol, res2, up)
    for i_ = 1:i_njac
        @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_nnode - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_ttgc_8!(i_nnode, mup)
        @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_ncell - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_ttgc_9!(cell_vol, i_cell_to_node, i_ncell, mup, up)
        @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_nnode - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_ttgc_10!(i_nnode, mup, node_vol, res2, up)
    end
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_nnode - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_ttgc_11!(i_nnode, loss, u, up, uref)
    return nothing
end



using CUDA
using JSON3
using Random
Random.seed!(20260823)

i_ncell, i_nnode, i_njac = 4000, 1200, 3
dt = 0.01

u        = randn(i_nnode);  uref = randn(i_nnode)
cell_vol = rand(i_ncell) .+ 1.0
node_vol = rand(i_nnode) .+ 1.0
skx = randn(4, i_ncell);  sky = randn(4, i_ncell);  skz = randn(4, i_ncell)
c   = randn(3, i_nnode)
beta  = fill(0.3, i_ncell);  gamma = fill(0.7, i_ncell)
i_cell_to_node = rand(1:i_nnode, 4, i_ncell)

scratch() = (zeros(i_nnode), zeros(i_nnode), zeros(i_nnode), zeros(i_nnode), zeros(1))
z(x) = zeros(size(x))
d(x) = CuArray(copy(x))
zg(x) = CUDA.zeros(Float64, size(x)...)

# ---------- CPU primal ----------
(res, res2, up, mup, loss) = scratch()
ttgc(u, uref, i_cell_to_node, cell_vol, node_vol, skx, sky, skz, i_ncell, i_nnode,
     c, dt, beta, gamma, i_njac, res, res2, up, mup, loss)
primal_cpu = Dict("loss" => copy(loss), "res" => copy(res), "up" => copy(up))

# ---------- CPU adjoint ----------
seed = randn(1)
(res, res2, up, mup, loss) = scratch()
ub, urefb, cell_volb, node_volb = z(u), z(uref), z(cell_vol), z(node_vol)
skxb, skyb, skzb, cb = z(skx), z(sky), z(skz), z(c)
betab, gammab = z(beta), z(gamma)
resb, res2b, upb, mupb = z(res), z(res2), z(up), z(mup)
lossb = copy(seed)
st = initstacks_ttgc_b(i_ncell, i_njac, i_nnode)
dtb_cpu = ttgc_b(u, ub, uref, urefb, i_cell_to_node, cell_vol, cell_volb, node_vol, node_volb,
                 skx, skxb, sky, skyb, skz, skzb, i_ncell, i_nnode, c, cb, dt, 0.0,
                 beta, betab, gamma, gammab, i_njac, res, resb, res2, res2b,
                 up, upb, mup, mupb, loss, lossb, st...)
adj_cpu = Dict("ub" => copy(ub), "urefb" => copy(urefb), "cell_volb" => copy(cell_volb),
               "node_volb" => copy(node_volb), "skxb" => copy(skxb), "skyb" => copy(skyb),
               "skzb" => copy(skzb), "cb" => copy(cb), "betab" => copy(betab),
               "gammab" => copy(gammab))

# ---------- GPU primal ----------
(res, res2, up, mup, loss) = scratch()
g = (d(res), d(res2), d(up), d(mup), d(loss))
ttgc_cuda(d(u), d(uref), d(i_cell_to_node), d(cell_vol), d(node_vol), d(skx), d(sky), d(skz),
          i_ncell, i_nnode, d(c), dt, d(beta), d(gamma), i_njac, g...)
CUDA.synchronize()
primal_gpu = Dict("loss" => Array(g[5]), "res" => Array(g[1]), "up" => Array(g[3]))

# ---------- GPU adjoint ----------
(res, res2, up, mup, loss) = scratch()
g = (d(res), d(res2), d(up), d(mup), d(loss))
g_ub, g_urefb, g_cvb, g_nvb = zg(u), zg(uref), zg(cell_vol), zg(node_vol)
g_skxb, g_skyb, g_skzb, g_cb = zg(skx), zg(sky), zg(skz), zg(c)
g_betab, g_gammab = zg(beta), zg(gamma)
g_resb, g_res2b, g_upb, g_mupb = zg(res), zg(res2), zg(up), zg(mup)
g_st = initstacks_ttgc_b_cuda(i_ncell, i_njac, i_nnode)
dtb_gpu = ttgc_b_cuda(d(u), g_ub, d(uref), g_urefb, d(i_cell_to_node), d(cell_vol), g_cvb,
                      d(node_vol), g_nvb, d(skx), g_skxb, d(sky), g_skyb, d(skz), g_skzb,
                      i_ncell, i_nnode, d(c), g_cb, dt, 0.0, d(beta), g_betab,
                      d(gamma), g_gammab, i_njac, g[1], g_resb, g[2], g_res2b,
                      g[3], g_upb, g[4], g_mupb, g[5], d(seed), g_st...)
CUDA.synchronize()
adj_gpu = Dict("ub" => Array(g_ub), "urefb" => Array(g_urefb), "cell_volb" => Array(g_cvb),
               "node_volb" => Array(g_nvb), "skxb" => Array(g_skxb), "skyb" => Array(g_skyb),
               "skzb" => Array(g_skzb), "cb" => Array(g_cb), "betab" => Array(g_betab),
               "gammab" => Array(g_gammab))

relerr(a, b) = maximum(abs.(a .- b)) / max(1.0, maximum(abs.(a)))
report = Dict{String,Any}("device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())))
for k in sort(collect(keys(primal_cpu)))
    report["primal_" * k] = relerr(primal_cpu[k], primal_gpu[k])
end
for k in sort(collect(keys(adj_cpu)))
    report[k] = relerr(adj_cpu[k], adj_gpu[k])
end
report["dtb"] = abs(dtb_cpu - dtb_gpu) / max(1.0, abs(dtb_cpu))
report["max_rel_err"] = maximum(Float64[v for (k, v) in report if v isa Float64])
report["all_close"] = report["max_rel_err"] < 1e-10
report["sizes"] = Dict("i_ncell" => i_ncell, "i_nnode" => i_nnode, "i_njac" => i_njac)
println(JSON3.write(report))
